title: Multi Block Feature
description: `minecraft:multi_block_feature` places a multi-block in the world as a biome decoration feature. A multi-block must be defined with the 'minecraft:multi_block' trait.

places_block.title: Places Block
places_block.description: Reference to the multi-block to be placed, must be the first part of a multi-block.

enforce_placement_rules.title: Enforce Placement Rules
enforce_placement_rules.description: If true, enforce the block's mayPlace check.

randomize_rotation.title: Randomize Rotation
randomize_rotation.description: If true, randomizes the block's cardinal orientation.

may_replace.title: May Replace
may_replace.description: A list of blocks that may be replaced during placement. Omit this field to allow any block to be replaced, except other multi-blocks.

items.title: Block
items.description: A block that may be replaced during placement
